import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc['word/document.xml']
dom = editor.dom
body = dom.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0]

print("=== BODY CHILDREN (tag sequence) ===")
for child in body.childNodes:
    if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE:
        print(child.tagName)

print()
print("=== PARAGRAPHS ===")
for i, p in enumerate(body.getElementsByTagName('w:p')):
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        if t.firstChild:
            texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue)
    style = ""
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')
    if pPr:
        pStyle = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')
        if pStyle and pStyle[0].getAttribute('w:val'):
            style = pStyle[0].getAttribute('w:val')
    txt = "".join(texts)
    print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={txt!r}")

print()
print("=== STYLES AVAILABLE (paragraph styles) ===")
styles_editor = doc['word/styles.xml']
for s in styles_editor.dom.getElementsByTagName('w:style'):
    if s.getAttribute('w:type') == 'paragraph':
        sid = s.getAttribute('w:styleId')
        name = ""
        for n in s.getElementsByTagName('w:name'):
            name = n.getAttribute('w:val')
        print(f"styleId={sid!r} name={name!r}")

path = 'unpacked/word/document.xml'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='ascii') as f:
    content = f.read()

marker = '<w:sectPr/>'
idx = content.rfind(marker)
if idx == -1:
    raise SystemExit('ERROR: <w:sectPr/> marker not found')

rpr = ('<w:rPr>\n'
       '            <w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" w:cs="Helvetica Light"/>\n'
       '            <w:sz w:val="24"/>\n'
       '            <w:sz-cs w:val="24"/>\n'
       '          </w:rPr>')

def ins_p(wid, text):
    return ('    <w:ins w:id="%d" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-15T10:00:00Z">\n'
            '      <w:p>\n'
            '        <w:pPr/>\n'
            '        <w:r w:rsidR="A5683793">\n'
            '          %s\n'
            '          <w:t xml:space="preserve">%s</w:t>\n'
            '        </w:r>\n'
            '      </w:p>\n'
            '    </w:ins>\n') % (wid, rpr, text)

paragraphs = []
paragraphs.append(ins_p(1, ''))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(2, 'RECOMMENDATIONS'))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(3, ''))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(4, 'Based on fourth quarter results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management recommends the following actions to sustain growth, protect profitability, and address the key risks outlined above:'))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(5, '• Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing segment (+22.8% YoY), by expanding capacity and entering new international markets.'))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(6, '• Extend operational efficiency programs that raised operating margin to 23.1%, targeting sustained margins above 22% through procurement and automation.'))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(7, '• Build on customer retention gains, capitalizing on the 14.1% increase in customer lifetime value and the 8.3% reduction in acquisition costs.'))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(8, '• Maintain hedging strategies and diversify suppliers to mitigate currency and supply chain risks ahead of international expansion.'))
paragraphs.append(ins_p(9, 'These actions are expected to support the projected 10-13% revenue growth while preserving operating discipline and strengthening the company\'s competitive position.'))

section = ''.join(paragraphs)

new_content = content[:idx] + section + content[idx:]

with open(path, 'w', encoding='ascii') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

print('marker at', idx)
print('old length', len(content), 'new length', len(new_content))
print('--- inserted region preview ---')
print(new_content[idx - 40:idx + 300])

import xml.dom.minidom

dom = xml.dom.minidom.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')  # raises if malformed
body = dom.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0]
paras = body.getElementsByTagName('w:p')
print('XML is well-formed. Total paragraphs:', len(paras))
print('Total w:ins elements:', len(dom.getElementsByTagName('w:ins')))
print()
print('=== Last 12 paragraphs (parent tag | text) ===')
for p in paras[-12:]:
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        if t.firstChild:
            texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue)
    parent = p.parentNode.tagName
    print(f'{parent} | {repr("".join(texts))}')
